Trimueil

Original: https://shrouded-lands.fandom.com/wiki/Trimueil

An exiled poet and bard of some renown, and a rival of Cleramon. The rivalry played out across all the taverns in the Shuttered City.

Trimueil popularised the legend that the burning eagle and the grey worm represent the opposing elements of fire and water, and that the two creatures have been mortal enemies since the dawn times.

Trimueil is sometimes spoken of in the past tense, but he was alive as recently as seven years ago, when he delved a dungeon with disastrous consequences (39.12).

Works

  • The Black Duke of Thring, which presumably predates the play The Song of Ban and Ulena.

  • The Song of Ban and Ulena, a play, the only copy of which was seized by Trimueil when the production proved disastrous.

  • An epic poem also called The Song of Ban and Ulena, the only copy of which was lost seven years ago in the aforementioned dungeon.

Connections

  • Algrael the Gelderer is one of many poets who learned their verse at the feet of Trimueil.

  • Among the captives of Skullreach is someone who imitated the poet Trimueil to woo a lady.
